primary_claim: SAE transferability from base to finetuned models is highly model-dependent: an SAE trained on Gemma-2b degrades drastically on a Python-code finetune while an SAE trained on Mistral-7B transfers well to a MetaMath finetune, and residual-activation similarity (cosine/Euclidean distance) between base and finetuned models anecdotally predicts this transferability.

effect.metric: Reconstruction CE Loss Delta / R^2 variance explained, base vs finetuned model with same SAE

contradicts_or_qualifies: Extends Kissane et al.'s base-to-chat-model SAE transfer study to a further full-finetuning step (base to task-finetuned model), and results agree that SAE transferability is model-dependent and sensitive to the finetuning process
stated_future_work: A more principled approach using a custom finetuning setup to study the relationship between compute spent finetuning and key SAE transferability metrics
A more thorough study of how results vary across different layers and different SAE activations (e.g. MLP or attention head activations)
Extend results to the more specific setting of finetuned-task data, since experiments were run only on the base SAE's original training distribution
Replicate circuit analysis in the SAE basis to rigorously prove whether transferring features are still involved in the same computation in the finetuned model
limitations_stated: Not clear how results generalize to other finetunes; a more principled approach would use a custom finetuning setup

Finetuned models had almost the same tokenizer/dictionary as the base model, so it's unclear whether results generalize to finetunes with significantly modified dictionaries (e.g. new-language finetunes)
Only a single residual layer was studied for each of Gemma-2b and Mistral-7B
All experiments were performed on the base SAE's original training distribution rather than the finetuned model's actual use distribution
The transferability analysis did not include a thorough investigation of feature interpretability after finetuning
quote: We got drastically different results for our Gemma-2b-python-codes and Mistral-7B-MetaMath finetunes.
